other_conditions: Disability of at least 50% as certified by a medical officer
Resident of West Bengal for a minimum of 10 years at the date of application
Family income must not exceed ₹1,00,000 per month
Declared unsuitable for physical work by the respective medical officer
benefits_summary: Provides a pension of Rs 1,000 per month transferred directly to the beneficiary’s bank account.
documents_required: Self attested copies of Disability Certificate from Appropriate Authority
Copy of front page of Bank Pass Book
